description: Advocacy / patient-organization registry. Stable ids used as FKs from content-suggestor tactics. Indication-scoped via indication_ids. Focus areas, audience segments, and channels are coarse and editorial — refine with primary research before treating reach figures as quantitative. Initial scope: lupus / lupus-nephritis-relevant US organizations. Add new orgs to this file before referencing them from tactic data.
notes: estimated_reach is qualitative (national / regional / local / niche) until we have actual newsletter and membership numbers.
partnership_modes are the formats this org HAS historically supported, not an offer of partnership.
Some orgs (NephCure, American Kidney Fund) are nephrology-first but engage LN through the kidney-disease lens; flagged via secondary_indication_relevance.

items.label: Lupus Foundation of America
items.description: The largest US lupus advocacy organization. National scope with regional chapters; runs the National Resource Center on Lupus, Lupus Awareness Month, and Capitol Hill advocacy.

items.label: Lupus Research Alliance
items.description: Largest private funder of lupus research in the US. Runs Lupus Therapeutics, which operates the LuCIN clinical-trial network — strategically relevant for any trial-recruitment-support strategy.

items.label: Kaleidoscope Fighting Lupus
items.description: Patient-led nonprofit with a strong digital media output (podcast, video). Lower barrier to partnership than the LFA tier; good fit for peer_storytelling and lifestyle_normalization strategies.

items.label: S.L.E. Lupus Foundation
items.description: Bicoastal foundation (LA and NY chapters) with research-funding focus. Smaller reach than LFA but high editorial trust within its community.

items.label: Lupus and Allied Diseases Association
items.description: Policy-leaning organization that co-chairs the Lupus and Allied Diseases Foundation policy coalition. Relevant when payer_navigation or hcp_enablement strategies need a policy backbone.

items.label: NephCure
items.description: Kidney-disease-first advocacy reaching LN through the proteinuric-kidney-disease lens. Good fit for content that emphasizes the kidney side of LN (biopsy, proteinuria monitoring) rather than the systemic-lupus framing.

items.label: American Kidney Fund
items.description: Provides direct financial assistance for kidney-related costs. The credible voice for payer_navigation strategies; will not co-brand product-adjacent content but does collaborate on access-and-affordability education.

items.label: Global Healthy Living Foundation
items.description: Multi-disease auto-immune advocacy with a sizable patient-research arm (ArthritisPower, CreakyJoints). Good fit for cross-condition lifestyle and HCP-enablement content.

items.label: Molly's Fund Fighting Lupus
items.description: Smaller, youth-and-AYA-focused organization. Strategic value when targeting newly-diagnosed adolescents and young adults — a notoriously hard-to-reach segment for lupus.

items.label: Lupus LA
items.description: Los Angeles regional foundation. Strong donor and event base; regional rather than national reach. Often partners with S.L.E. Lupus Foundation.
